tasks.title: Conversation #96
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I see that the leaves in the backyard still haven't been raked. Weren't you planning to do that?
Man: I've been working on a lecture for my English class all morning. Maybe tomorrow?
Woman: Well, it's supposed to rain tomorrow. It might be your last chance before everything gets soggy.
Man: Good point. I'll head out after lunch. I just hope I can find the rake. I'm pretty sure I lent it to Sarah, our neighbor last month. I'll give her a call about it.

questions.stem: Why does the woman encourage the man to complete a task today?

options.B: The weather will be bad tomorrow.
options.C: The book he's using is overdue.
options.D: They have an important meeting tomorrow.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士为什么鼓励男士今天完成一项任务？ 定位原文：Woman: Well, it‘s supposed to rain tomorrow. It might be your last chance before everything gets soggy. 选项分析： A. His students requested it. 他的学生要求的。对话中未提及学生，所以A选项错误。 B. The weather will be bad tomorrow. 明天天气会不好。女士明确说明天有雨，今天不扫叶子就会被淋湿，所以B选项正确。 C. The book he's using is overdue. 他用的书逾期未还。对话中未提及书籍或借阅，所以C选项错误。 D. They have an important meeting tomorrow. 他们明天有个重要会议。对话中未提及会议，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man say about a neighbor?

options.A: She will help him with some work.
options.C: She is out of town for several days.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：男士对邻居说了什么？ 定位原文：Man: I’m pretty sure I lent it to Sarah, our neighbor last month. I'll give her a call about it. 选项分析： A. She will help him with some work. 她会帮他干活。对话中未提及邻居帮忙干活，所以A选项错误。 B. She called a maintenance crew. 她叫了维修人员。对话中未提及维修人员，所以B选项错误。 C. She is out of town for several days. 她出城几天了。对话中未提及邻居外出，所以C选项错误。 D. She borrowed something from him. 她从他那里借了东西。男士明确说他把耙子（the rake）借给了邻居Sarah，所以D选项正确。
